script: There is water ice on the Moon. It hides in craters near the poles that never see sunlight. Some of those craters are colder than the surface of Pluto. Future astronauts might use that ice for drinking water and rocket fuel. NASA's Artemis program plans to land astronauts near the Moon's south pole.
